name: ZO Future Group
summary: ZO Future Group, an investment holding company, operates a professional football club in Hong Kong, the United Kingdom, Singapore, the People's Republic of China, Cambodia, and Japan. The company invests and manages residential and commercial properties. It also involved in new energy automobiles and related business, which includes selling and leasing of commercial automobiles; and provision of automobiles repair and maintenance services, management, automobiles accessories and equipment, and charging services.
